final_wiki.Q-7281: The number of days from 2023-11-24 to 2024-05-31 is 189 days. Calculation: Nov (30-24=6), Dec (31), Jan (31), Feb (29 - leap year), Mar (31), Apr (30), May (31). Total: 6+31+31+29+31+30+31 = 189.
